correctness.rationale: All singular values follow exactly from diagonal Toeplitz gamma moments and the orthogonal monomial coordinate shift. The gamma recurrence yields the uniform O(m^-2) first-difference remainder; the multiindex beta Riemann sum produces the dimension-dependent residue. Positive phase arcs ensure the sharp Schatten exclusion and the fixed-factor comparison between sorted and degree cutoffs; the O(1) sorted logarithmic law proves Dixmier measurability. The standalone checker separately verifies 448 finite identities and approximations without treating them as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The original radial Toeplitz operator retains nondecaying boundary oscillations, yet its coordinate commutator is compact with a sharp dimension-dependent Schatten threshold. Its critical trace is measurable and explicit despite the absence of any boundary value, revealing a new residue mechanism via the Mellin–Gamma filter and higher-dimensional monomial multiplicity. The sharp constant specializes to closed gamma-function formulas for the natural cosine family.
